productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main source baseline only; no verified live runtime.

AdMob and other Wall video playback

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Enable private short video replies in public Wall composer without changing auth or navigation
preservedBehaviors: Preserve account-bound comment sheet, existing routes and media signing

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Enable short video comments in scoped communities using existing scoped storage/RLS
preservedBehaviors: Preserve Cluster/Org membership isolation, comment RPC and moderation

selectionRationale: The app already has private community-media signed uploads, authenticated comment RPCs, and expo-video included in its native runtime. Extend the versioned comment attachment format and lazy playback to avoid new tables, runtime plugins, media exposure, or costly autoplay while retaining scope RLS and backward compatibility.
alternativeApproaches: New comment_video database table and migration: rejected because it requires schema and RLS rollout and increases release risk; existing comment body media header supports backward-compatible attachments.
Host public MP4 links or use autoplaying Community Wall video player for every comment: rejected due to privacy exposure, excessive bandwidth and media initialization affecting scroll and AdMob.
Use inline base64 blob in comment body: rejected because it bypasses private storage, inflates RPC payload and breaks mobile network reliability.
